facts.value: A one-page motivation letter, CV, and relevant certificates in copies (including: high school diploma; BA degree or transcript of records or equivalent degrees).
Proof of knowledge of two foreign languages: English at B2 level and a second modern foreign language at B1 level.
International students need a DSH-1 certificate.
Applications should be submitted by mail in a simple version and additionally electronically (consolidated into a PDF document) to the specified addresses.
Curatorial Studies – Theory – History – Criticism, Art History Institute of Goethe University, Goethe University Frankfurt am Main, 60629 Frankfurt.
The application documents will not be returned.
